# Privacy treatment of vendor material

Manufacturer material remains in its supplied language. Public PDF copies have
unit-specific serial numbers and machine-readable unit labels permanently
redacted. The redaction removes the underlying image pixels and text, rather
than adding a reversible overlay. Technical diagrams, PCB silkscreen, product
variant identifiers and manufacturer contact information are retained outside
the redacted areas. The PDF metadata identifies these copies as privacy-redacted.

Affected public copies:

- [BatteryMonitor User Manual](<docs/batterymonitor/BatteryMonitor User Manual.pdf>)
- [Seplos BMS V16 100A Manual](<docs/manuals/Seplos BMS V16 100A Manual.pdf>)
- [Seplos BMS V16 200A Manual](<docs/manuals/Seplos BMS V16 200A Manual.pdf>)
- [Seplos BMS 48150-1101-10E specification](<docs/specs/Seplos BMS 48150-1101-10E (EN).pdf>)
- [LCD004 Bluetooth display specification](<docs/specs/displays/LCD004 Display with Bluetooth (EN).pdf>)
- [SH Energy BMS catalogue](<docs/oem catalog/SH Energy BMS-Catalog.pdf>)

Two standalone hardware photographs and the product demonstration video contain
unit identifiers and are not published. Unmodified originals and exact redaction
evidence are retained privately under ignored `local/`. Historical PDF copies
receive the same treatment, including documents absent from the current tree.

OEM firmware images, MCU SDK archives and vendor software distributions remain
unchanged. These privacy edits do not alter protocol definitions, firmware
identity checks or the scope of hardware evidence. Vendor copyright and third-party
licensing remain with their original owners.
